item.title: The Almanac 0.2.0
item.description:
• A new welcome for new users: a short chat, then a new opening where a line lifts into the Almanac's infinity. Already set up? See it with Help › Replay welcome.
  • While an answer is on its way, a soft light now glides along the infinity.
  • Delete conversations: right-click one in the sidebar, or File › Delete Conversation… (⌘⌫). Deleted conversations go to the Trash.
  • Closing the window no longer quits the Almanac. It stays in the Dock; click the Dock icon or press ⌘0 to bring it back.

item.title: The Almanac 0.1.0
item.description:
• First release: ask questions of your offline library and read the cited sources.
  • The Almanac now checks for updates once a day (The Almanac › Check for Updates… checks now).
